caseNameFull: Estate of Pratt v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Roland L. Redmond for petitioners., Solicitor General McGrath, Assistant Attorney General McGregor, Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch and L. W. Post for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy took no part in the consideration or decision of this application. Roland L. Redmond for petitioners. Solicitor General McGrath, Assistant Attorney General McGregor, Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch and L. W. Post for respondent.
